title: MedAction: Towards Active Multi-turn Clinical Diagnostic LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.07305v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Most existing LLM diagnoses are evaluated on static, single-turn settings where complete patient information is provided upfront, an oversimplification of real clinical practice. We study active diagnosis: the real-life clinical process of starting from initial observation, ordering tests, interpreting results, and updating a differential diagnosis across multiple turns. Through systematic analysis, we identify three recurring failure modes in current LLMs: ungrounded test ordering, unreliable diagnostic update, and degraded multi-turn coherence. Together, these failures reveal a core deficit: existing medical training data teaches models to reason from complete information but not to act under evolving, partial evidence. To address this gap, we introduce MedAction, a tree-structured distillation pipeline that synthesizes diverse and high-quality multi-turn diagnostic trajectories via LLM-environment interaction. translated_title: MedAction：迈向主动式多轮临床诊断大语言模型
translated_abstract: 现有的大多数大语言模型诊断评估都是在静态、单轮的设置下进行的，即预先提供完整的患者信息，这是对真实临床实践的过度简化。我们研究主动式诊断：即从初始观察开始、开具检查、解读结果，并在多轮过程中不断更新鉴别诊断的真实临床流程。通过系统性分析，我们识别出当前大语言模型中三种反复出现的失败模式：缺乏依据的检查开具、不可靠的诊断更新，以及多轮对话中连贯性的退化。这些失败共同揭示了一个核心缺陷：现有的医学训练数据教会模型基于完整信息进行推理，却没有教会模型在不断演变的部分证据下采取行动。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 MedAction，这是一个树状结构的蒸馏流水线，通过大语言模型与环境的交互，合成多样化且高质量的多轮诊断轨迹。我们提出了两种……
tldr: 提出MedAction树状结构蒸馏流水线，通过大语言模型与环境交互合成高质量多轮诊断轨迹，使模型学会在部分证据下主动开具检查、解读结果并更新鉴别诊断，克服了静态单轮诊断评估的局限。
en_tdlr: MedAction proposes a tree-structured distillation pipeline that synthesizes diverse, high-quality multi-turn diagnostic trajectories via LLM-environment interaction, enabling models to actively order tests, interpret results, and update differential diagnoses under evolving, partial evidence.
